ordered_diagnoses: Tricuspid valve endocarditis due to Staphylococcus aureus

s1.syndrome_frame: Acute presentation of severe back pain, chest pain, and episodes of light-headedness with a history of infective endocarditis and recent tricuspid valve replacement
salient_findings: Tachycardia with heart rates between 150 and 190 beats per minute
Hypotension with blood pressure 94/60 mm Hg
key_facts: Female patient in her 40s
History of infective endocarditis
History of hepatitis C
Ongoing intravenous drug use
Recent tricuspid valve replacement with a 29-mm bioprosthetic Carpentier-Edwards valve
Transient third-degree heart block after tricuspid valve replacement
Pacemaker placement two days prior to presentation
Episodes of light-headedness and chest pain after pacemaker placement
Blood pressure 94/60 mm Hg
Heart rates between 150 and 190 beats per minute
Electrocardiogram showed P waves upright in leads II, III, and aVF with sinus rate of 96 beats per minute
Grouped beating pattern with 1 P wave producing 2 QRS complexes on electrocardiogram
Transesophageal echocardiography revealed pulmonic valve vegetations
Severe tricuspid valve regurgitation secondary to a flail leaflet
